title: 3D Print Library Integration
highlights: 3D Print Library: Integrated 3D model asset catalog supporting STL, 3MF, OBJ, and STEP files.
Interactive 3D Viewer: Built-in 3D model viewer with build plate grid, wireframe toggle, and rotation.
Bambu Lab Integration: Send print jobs directly to Bambu Lab P2S with AMS 2 Pro filament mapping.
1-Click Desktop Launchers: Open models directly in Bambu Studio or Autodesk Fusion 360.
Print Timelapses: Upload and play back chamber timelapse recordings with instant video streaming.

title: Website Blacklisting & Instant Tag Filtering
highlights: Website Blacklisting in Browser Extension: Added a Shield/Ban button to the floating extension widget to permanently block entire websites from being recorded to Neural Links or Timeline.
fixes: Instant Tag Filtering: Clicking tags in the sidebar or tag cloud now immediately displays matching results and refines them as you select more tags.
Tag Cloud Display: Normalized tag text sizes in the Neural Query tag cloud for a cleaner layout.

title: Live News Feed Refresh
fixes: Fixed outdated news in LinkForge Pulse and improved feed refresh.

fixes: Book mismatch in Book Vault fixed.

title: Universal Neural Search, Live AI Monitor & Browser Importer
highlights: ✨ Universal Neural Query: Unified semantic search across all web bookmarks and YouTube videos simultaneously
⚡ Live AI Background Monitor: Neon purple animated notification widget tracking AI reasoning and routing in real time
🌐 Browser Bookmarks Importer: Full Netscape HTML importer for Brave, Chrome, Edge, and Firefox with automatic folder categorisation
🤖 AI Sysadmin Test Handshake: Instant one-click connection and latency testing in Admin Settings
🔒 Private GitHub Repository Support: Seamless update support for private repos with token authentication
fixes: Fixed empty tag swarm visibility for newly imported browser bookmarks
Fixed duplicate search result cards when videos existed in both links and video library
Added instant 0ms local keyword search fallback when AI API keys are not configured
